entries.name: xinMetaPlugin
entries.description: 官方提供的 2b2t.xin 服务器适配与登录插件。
entries.descriptionEn: Official server adapter and login plugin for 2b2t.xin.

entries.name: MovementSync
entries.description: 记录地形并提供移动管理能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Records terrain and provides movement management capabilities.

entries.name: xinRemote
entries.description: 提供 XinBot 远程控制能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Provides remote control capabilities for XinBot.

entries.name: BackToTheBase
entries.description: 触发末影珍珠机关以返回基地。
entries.descriptionEn: Triggers ender pearl mechanisms to return to base.

entries.name: Envy
entries.description: 根据聊天内容自动发送羡慕回复。
entries.descriptionEn: Automatically responds to matching chat content.

entries.name: XinClaw
entries.description: 基于 LangChain4j 的 XinBot AI 插件。
entries.descriptionEn: An AI plugin for XinBot based on LangChain4j.

entries.name: XinPga
entries.description: 支持多模式、多语言和远程控制的消息发送插件。
entries.descriptionEn: A messaging plugin with multiple modes, languages, and remote control.

entries.name: XinChatCommandPlugin
entries.description: 可扩展的聊天命令框架。
entries.descriptionEn: An extensible chat command framework for XinBot.

entries.name: SurvivalManager
entries.description: 提供防挂机、背包管理、反击和好友系统等生存管理能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Provides anti-AFK, inventory, retaliation, friend, and survival management features.

entries.name: XinBls
entries.description: 存储 XinBot 的终端输出信息。

entries.name: ChatFilter
entries.description: 过滤敏感词并隐藏重复或相似的聊天消息。
entries.descriptionEn: Filters profanity and hides repeated or similar chat messages.

entries.name: LanConnect
entries.description: 通过可配置的规则链适配不同服务器。
entries.descriptionEn: Adapts to different servers through configurable rule chains.

entries.name: MovementMCP
entries.description: 通过 MCP 协议提供移动、感知和操作工具。
entries.descriptionEn: Exposes movement, perception, and action tools through MCP.

entries.name: XinVia
entries.description: 为 Meta 插件提供 ViaVersion 和 ViaBackwards 跨版本支持。
entries.descriptionEn: Provides ViaVersion and ViaBackwards support for Meta plugins.

entries.name: CnOrgMetaPlugin
entries.description: 2b2t-cn.org 的登录、跨版本、保活和大厅适配插件。
entries.descriptionEn: Login, cross-version, keep-alive, and lobby adapter for 2b2t-cn.org.

entries.name: XinPlayerMonitor
entries.description: 将玩家上线、下线、聊天和状态数据持续记录到 SQLite。
entries.descriptionEn: Continuously records player activity, chat, and status data to SQLite.

entries.name: Xinbot_InfoManage
entries.description: 查询服务器状态和玩家信息，并支持多服务器监控。
entries.descriptionEn: Queries server and player information with multi-server monitoring support.
